FN-EJLJ39C-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 89
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/14/2026
Senate Bill 89 as introduced would repeal obsolete laws establishing the State Pilotage
Commission and requirements for bar pilots. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local
funding.
